box.why: square 16px button whose paint changes unchecked → checked (bg rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) → oklch(0.205 0 0))

glyph.why: svg 14px×14px present in the checked combo

glyphPath.why: path inside the svg, stroke oklch(0.985 0 0) 2px, d=path("M 20 6 L 9 17 L 4 12")

label.why: no part carries text — a bare control; the recipe compiles no label node and label leaves become bare-cell spellings

row.why: no label, so no row is read (row.gap and rowAlign are bare-cell spellings)

hit.why: no larger square parent; the box is its own hit area

dash.why: no distinct indeterminate mark part; dash leaves will be receipts
